note: Append-only. Maps a legacy or shorthand name to a catalog machine id. Entries are only ever added: removing one orphans every saved graph that still holds that string. `why` explains each, and is not read by the app.

why.Cleanroom: Same controller, MTECleanroom; the game shows 'Cleanroom Controller'.
why.Electric Air Filter: Split into T1/T2/T3. Points at the lowest tier — a node holding the old name keeps its machine and the tier is re-picked.
why.Industrial Arc Furnace: Renamed upstream; still MTEIndustrialArcFurnace, unlocalized name unchanged.
why.Large Sifter: Same controller, MTEIndustrialSifter; the game shows 'Large Sifter Control Block'.
why.Network Switch With QoS: Two variants now. The plain one is MTENetworkSwitch, whose display name gained the 'Weighted' prefix.
why.Sparge Tower: Same controller, MTESpargeTower; the game shows 'Sparge Tower Controller'.
why.TFFT: The game spells it T.F.F.T. Kept because the app shipped the unpunctuated form.
why.Industrial Bending Machine: Merged into MTEIndustrialPlatePress, which still carries the unlocalized name industrialbender.controller.tier.single.
why.Industrial Forming Press: The other half of the same merge — bender and plate press are one machine now.
why.Industrial Chemical Bath: Folded into MTEIndustrialWashPlant, which runs chemical bath recipes as one of its modes.
why.Mass Solidifier: Same controller, MTEMultiSolidifier; renamed to Fluid Shaper.
why.Void Miner: Split into I/II/III. Points at the lowest tier, as with the air filter.
why.Compact Fusion Reactor: Split into MK-I through MK-V. Points at the lowest tier.
why.Fusion Reactor: Split into Fusion Control Computer Mark I through III. Points at the lowest tier.
why.EBF: Community shorthand. The initials search covers it too, but an exact alias makes the lookup deterministic.
why.Adv EBF: What the wiki and the community call Volcanus.
why.Advanced Electric Blast Furnace: Volcanus' descriptive name, and what this app shipped before the catalog.
